RASS2RXS - Second ROSAT All-Sky Survey Point Source Catalog (2RXS) Search in Xamin or Browse ... RASS2RXS - Second ROSAT All-Sky Survey Point Source Catalog (2RXS) HEASARC Archive Overview This database table contains the Second ROSAT All-Sky Survey Point Source
Catalog (2RXS). This is the second publicly released ROSAT catalog of
point-like sources obtained from the ROSAT All-Sky Survey (RASS) observations
performed with the Position-Sensitive Proportional Counter (PSPC) between
June 1990 and August 1991. It is an extended, revised, and combined version
of the RASS Bright and Faint Source Catalog s. Utilizing the latest
RASS processing, this catalog includes more than 135,000 X-ray detections in
the 0.1-2.4 keV energy band down to a likelihood threshold of 6.5. Additional information can be found at http://www.mpe.mpg.de/ROSAT/2RXS/ . Catalog Bibcode 2016A&A...588A.103B References Second ROSAT all-sky survey (2RXS) source catalog.
    Boller T., Freyberg M.J., Truemper J., Haberl F., Voges W., Nandra K.
    <Astron. Astrophys. 588, A103 (2016)>
    = 2016A&A...588A.103B (SIMBAD/NED BibCode) Provenance This table was created by the HEASARC in March, 2017, based on CDS Catalog
J/A+A/588/A103 file cat2rxs.dat.gz. Parameters Entry_Number A sequential identification number for each entry in catalog. Name The IAU source designation. Skyfield_Number For computational and analysis purposes, the ROSAT All-Sky Survey scans were
  broken up into a number of individual observing sequences called sky fields.
  The skyfield_number represents the RASS sequence ID number of the sky field. Skyfield_Source_Number The number of the individual source in a given sky field observing sequence. Detection_Likelihood The statistic derived from the maximum likelihood source detection analysis. Counts The background-corrected source counts. Counts_Error The error in the background-corrected source counts. Count_Rate The background-corrected source count rate, in counts per second, presumably
  in the PHA range 11-235. Count_Rate_Error The error in the background-corrected source count rate, in counts per second. Exposure The source exposure time in seconds. RA The source right ascension. Dec The source declination. LII The source galactic longitude. BII The source galactic latitude. Lambda The source ecliptic longitude, in degrees. Beta The source ecliptic latitude, in degrees. Source_Extent The source extent in image pixels. Source_Extent_Error The error in the source extent in image pixels. Source_Extent_Prob The probability of the source extent. Hardness_Ratio_1 This hardness ratio is calculated from the source counts in the PSPC and
  defined as HR 1 = (B-A)/(B+A), where A is the PSPC channel range 11-41 and B
  is the PSPC channel range 52-201. Each channel can be approximately converted
  to energy by multiplying the channel number by 10 eV. Hardness_Ratio_1_Error The error in hardness ratio 1. Hardness_Ratio_2 This hardness ratio is calculated from the source counts in the PSPC and
  defined as HR 2 = (D-C)/(D+C), where C is the PSPC channel range 52-90 and D
  is the PSPC channel range 91-201. Each channel can be approximately converted
  to energy by multiplying the channel number by 10 eV. Hardness_Ratio_2_Error The error in hardness ratio 2. Unique_Flag The number of the "unique" sub-image of the sky field used in the source
  detection. Sub-image numbers run from 1 to 9. A value of unique_flag of 0
  indicates a source detected in the full-field image only. Extended_Region_Flag A flag which indicates that the source lies in or near a region of extended
  emission, such as a supernova (a value of 0 means the source lies near region
  of extended emission, a value of 1 means the source does not lie near a
  region of extended emission). Nearby_Src_Det_Flag A flag which indicates detection of nearby sources (0=Best). Source_Quality_Flag The source detection quality flag (0=Good). Max_Amplitude The maximum variability amplitude, calculated from the maximum count rate and
  the minimum count rate, and the corresponding errors for each survey light
  curve. The maximum amplitude variation is calculated as the difference of the
  maximum count rate (minus its error) and the minimum count rate (plus its
  error). Mean_Count_Rate The mean source count rate, in counts per second. Mean_Count_Rate_Error The standard deviation of mean source count rate in counts per second. Lc_Counts The number of counts calculated from the light curve analysis. Min_Count_Rate The minimum source count rate in counts per second. Min_Count_Rate_Error The error in minimum source count rate in counts per second. Max_Count_Rate The maximum source count rate in counts per second. Max_Count_Rate_Error The error in maximum source count rate in counts per second. Lc_Chi2 The chi 2 statistic derived from the light curve analysis. Excess_Variance The normalized excess variance calculated from the source light curve
  analysis. The square of the normalized excess variance is defined as excess_variance 2 = 1/(N u 2 ) Sum(i=1,N) [(Xi - u) 2 - sigma_i 2 ] where N is the total number of counts, u the mean count rate, Xi the number
  in the i-th bin, and sigma_i the standard deviation of the i-th bin. Excess_Variance_Error The 1-sigma uncertainty in normalized excess variance. The square of the
  excess_variance_error is defined in equation (2) of Boller et al. 2016. Excess_Variance_Sigma The excess variance in units of the standard deviation, in sigma. NH_Gal The galactic neutral hydrogen density towards the source, in H atoms/cm 2 . PLaw_NH The calculated neutral hydrogen density for the source spectrum from the
  power law fit, in H atoms/cm 2 . PLaw_NH_Error The error in neutral hydrogen density derived from the power law fit to the
  source spectrum, in H atoms/cm 2 . PLaw_Norm The normalization derived from the power law fit to the source spectrum. PLaw_Norm_Error The error in normalization derived from the power law fit to the source
  spectrum. PLaw_Photon_Index The photon index derived from the power law fit to the source spectrum. PLaw_Photon_Index_Error The error in photon index derived from the power law fit to the source
  spectrum. PLaw_Count_Rate The source count rate derived from the power law fit to the source spectrum,
  in counts per second. PLaw_Flux The absorption-corrected flux derived from the power law fit to the source
  spectrum, in erg/s/cm 2 . PLaw_Chi2_Reduced The reduced chi 2 statistic derived from the power law fit to the source
  spectrum. PLaw_Chi2 The chi 2 statistic of the power law fit to the source spectrum. PLaw_Number_Data_Pts The number of data points used in the power law fit to the source spectrum. PLaw_DoF The number of degrees of freedom in the power law fit to the source spectrum. Mekal_NH The neutral hydrogen density for the Mewe-Kaastra-Liedahl (mekal) thermal
  plasma model fit to the source spectrum in H atoms/cm 2 . Mekal_NH_Error The error in neutral hydrogen density for the mekal model fit to the source
  spectrum in H atoms/cm 2 . Mekal_Norm The normalization for the mekal model fit to the source spectrum . Mekal_Norm_Error The error in normalization for the mekal model fit to the source spectrum. Mekal_Temperature The temperature of the mekal model fit to the source spectrum, in keV. Mekal_Temperature_Error The error in temperature of the mekal model fit to the source spectrum, in
  keV. Mekal_Count_Rate The count rate obtained from the mekal model fit to the source spectrum, in
  counts per second. Mekal_Flux The absorption-corrected flux derived from the mekal model fit to the source
  spectrum, in ergs/cm 2 /s. Mekal_Chi2_Reduced the reduced chi 2 statistic for mekal model fit to the source spectrum. Mekal_Chi2 The chi 2 statistic for the mekal model fit to the source spectrum. Mekal_Number_Data_Pts The number of data points used in the mekal model fit to the source spectrum. Mekal_DoF The number of degrees of freedom in the mekal model fit to the source
  spectrum. BB_NH The neutral hydrogen density derived from the black-body fit to the source
  spectrum, in H atoms/cm 2 . BB_NH_Error The error in neutral hydrogen density for the black-body fit to the source
  spectrum, in H atoms/cm 2 . BB_Norm The normalization for the black-body fit to the source spectrum. BB_Norm_Error The error in normalization for the black-body fit to the source spectrum. BB_Temperature The temperature of the black-body fit to the source spectrum, in keV. BB_Temperature_Error The error in temperature of the black-body fit to the source spectrum, in keV. BB_Count_Rate The count rate for the black-body fit to the source spectrum, in counts per
  second. BB_Flux The absorption-corrected flux from the black-body fit to the source spectrum,
  in ergs/cm 2 /s. BB_Chi2_Reduced The reduced chi 2 statistic for the black-body fit to the source spectrum. BB_Chi2 The chi 2 statistic for the black-body fit to the source spectrum. BB_Number_Data_Pts The number of data points used in the black-body fit to the source spectrum. BB_DoF The number of degrees of freedom in the black-body fit to the source
  spectrum. X_Pixel The X image coordinate of the source from the local sliding cell detection on
  an X-ray image of 512 by 512 pixels with 45 arcsecond square pixels. X_Pixel_Error The 1-sigma error in the X image coordinate of the source. Y_Pixel The Y image coordinate of the source from the local sliding cell detection on
  an X-ray image of 512 by 512 pixels with 45 arcsecond square pixels. Y_Pixel_Error The 1-sigma error in Y image coordinate of the source. X_Sky_Pixel The X sky coordinate of the source from the local sliding cell detection on
  the X-ray sub-image given by unique_flag having 0.5 arcsecond square pixels. Y_Sky_Pixel The Y sky coordinate of the source from the local sliding cell detection on
  the X-ray sub-image given by unique_flag having 0.5 arcsecond square pixels. Extraction_Radius The source extraction radius in sky pixels. Extraction_Radius_Frac The analyzed fraction of source extraction radius. Total_Photons The total number of photons read from the photon events table and analyzed by
  maximum likelihood algorithm. Bkg_In_Extr_Reg The background counts in the source extraction region. Vignetting_Factor The vignetting correction factor for the source. Remarks The remarks concerning any nearby source originating from the maximum
  likelihood detection. Band_A_Tot_Counts The total counts in band A. Band A includes PSPC energy channels 11 to 41. Band_B_Tot_Counts The total counts in band B. Band B includes PSPC energy channels 51 to 201. Band_C_Tot_Counts The total counts in band C. Band C includes PSPC energy channels 52 to 90. Band_D_Tot_Counts The total counts in band D. Band D includes PSPC energy channels 91 to 201. Band_A_Bkg_Counts The background band A with other catalog entries excised. Band A includes
  PSPC energy channels 11 to 41. Band_B_Bkg_Counts The background band B with other catalog entries excised. Band B includes
  PSPC energy channels 51 to 201. Band_C_Bkg_Counts The background band C with other catalog entries excised. Band C includes
  PSPC energy channels 52 to 90. Band_D_Bkg_Counts The background band D with other catalog entries excised. Band D includes
  PSPC energy channels 91 to 201. Remaining_Bkg_Area The remaining background area in arcmin 2 . Band_A_Counts The source counts in band A. Band A includes PSPC energy channels 11 to 41. Band_B_Counts The source counts in band B. Band B includes PSPC energy channels 51 to 201. Band_C_Counts The source counts in band C. Band C includes PSPC energy channels 52 to 90. Band_D_Counts The source counts in band D. Band D includes PSPC energy channels 91 to 201. XMMSL1_Number_Ctrprts The number of counterparts in the XMM slew survey within 60 arcseconds. XMMSL1_Nearest The source number of the nearest counterpart to the source in the XMM Slew
  Survey (XMMSL1). XMMSL1_Separation The distance of the nearest XMMSL1 counterpart in arcseconds. XMMSL1_Name The source designation in the First XMM-Newton Slew Survey Catalog (XMMSL1). XMMSL1_RA The right ascension of the nearest XMMSL1 source. XMMSL1_Dec The declination of the nearest XMMSL1 source. XMMSL1_BB_Count_Rate The broad-band count rate for nearest XMMSL1 source in counts per second. XMMSL1_BB_Count_Rate_Err The broad-band count rate error of the nearest XMMSL1 source in counts per
  second. XMMSL1_SB_Count_Rate The count rate in the energy band 0.5-2keV of the nearest XMMSL1 source in
  counts per second. XMMSL1_SB_Count_Rate_Err The count rate error in the energy band 0.5-2keV of the nearest XMMSL1 source
  in counts per second. ThreeXMM_Number_Ctrprts The number of the Third XMM Newton source catalog (3XMM) counterparts within
  60 arcseconds. ThreeXMM_Nearest The source number of the nearest counterpart to the 2RXS source in the 3XMM
  catalog. ThreeXMM_Separation The distance of the nearest 3XMM counterpart to the 2RXS source in
  arcseconds. ThreeXMM_Name The source designation of the nearest counterpart in the 3XMM catalog. ThreeXMM_RA The right ascension of the nearest 3XMM counterpart to the 2RXS source. ThreeXMM_Dec The declination of the nearest 3XMM counterpart to the 2RXS source. ThreeXMM_Count_Rate The EPIC count rate of the nearest 3XMM counterpart to the 2RXS source in
  counts per second. ThreeXMM_Count_Rate_Err The error on the EPIC count rate of the nearest 3XMM counterpart to the 2RXS
  source in counts per second. ThreeXMM_Flux The flux of the nearest 3XMM counterpart to the 2RXS source in ergs/cm 2 /s. ThreeXMM_Flux_Error The error of the flux of the nearest 3XMM counterpart to the 2RXS source in
  ergs/cm 2 /s. TwoRXP_Number_Ctrprts The number of counterparts within 300 arcsec of the 2RXS source in the Second
  ROSAT Pointed Source Catalog (2RXP). TwoRXP_Nearest The source number of the nearest counterpart in the 2RXP catalog to the 2RXS
  source. TwoRXP_Separation The distance of the nearest 2RXP counterpart from the 2RXS source in
  arcseconds. TwoRXP_Name The source designation in the 2RXP of the nearest counterpart to the 2RXS
  source. TwoRXP_RA The right ascension in the 2RXP of the nearest counterpart to the 2RXS source
  in degrees. TwoRXP_Dec The declination in the 2RXP of the nearest counterpart to the 2RXS source in
  degrees. TwoRXP_Count_Rate The count rate in the 2RXP of the nearest counterpart to the 2RXS source in
  counts per second. TwoRXP_Count_Rate_Error The error on the count rate in the 2RXP of the nearest counterpart to the
  2RXS source in counts per second. TwoRXP_Exposure The exposure time in the 2RXP of the nearest counterpart to the 2RXS source
  in seconds. TwoRXP_ObsID The field number in the 2RXP of the nearest counterpart to the 2RXS source. OneRXS_Number_Ctrprts The number of counterparts within 60 arcsec in the First ROSAT All Sky Survey
  Point Source Catalog (1RXS). OneRXS_Nearest The source number of the nearest counterpart to the 2RXS source in the 1RXS
  catalog. OneRXS_Separation The distance of the nearest counterpart in the 1RXS catalog to the 2RXS
  source in arcseconds. OneRXS_Name The source designation of the nearest counterpart in the 1RXS catalog to the
  2RXS source. OneRXS_RA The right ascension of the nearest counterpart in the 1RXS catalog to the
  2RXS source. OneRXS_Dec The declination of the nearest counterpart in the 1RXS catalog to the 2RXS
  source. OneRXS_Count_Rate The source count rate of the nearest counterpart in the 1RXS catalog to the
  2RXS source in counts per second. OneRXS_Count_Rate_Error The error in source count rate of the nearest counterpart in the 1RXS catalog
  to the 2RXS source in counts per second. OneRXS_Counts The background-corrected source counts of the nearest counterpart in the 1RXS
  catalog to the 2RXS source. OneRXS_Counts_Error The error in the background-corrected source counts of the nearest
  counterpart in the 1RXS catalog to the 2RXS source. OneRXS_Det_Likelihood The detection likelihood of the nearest counterpart in the 1RXS catalog to
  the 2RXS source. OneRXS_Exposure The source exposure time of the nearest counterpart in the 1RXS catalog to
  the 2RXS source in seconds. OneRXS_HR_1 The 1RXS hardness ratio 1 of the nearest counterpart in the 1RXS catalog to
  the 2RXS source. OneRXS_HR_1_Error The error in HR1 of the nearest counterpart in the 1RXS catalog to the 2RXS
  source. OneRXS_HR_2 The hardness ratio 2 of the nearest counterpart in the 1RXS catalog to the
  2RXS source. OneRXS_HR_2_Error The error in HR2 of the nearest counterpart in the 1RXS catalog to the 2RXS
  source. Veron_Number_Ctrprts The number of counterparts in the Veron-Cetty and Veron (VV10) Catalog of
  Quasars and Active Galactic Nuclei (2010) within 60 arcsec of the 2RXS
  source. Veron_Nearest The source number of VV10 nearest counterpart to the 2RXS source. Veron_Separation The distance of the nearest VV10 counterpart to the 2RXS source in
  arcseconds. Veron_Name The VV10 source designation of the nearest VV10 counterpart to the 2RXS
  source. Veron_Type The flag that indicates object type of the nearest VV10 counterpart to the
  2RXS source: B = Blazar; A = AGN; Q = quasar. Veron_Vmag The V magnitude of the nearest VV10 counterpart to the 2RXS source. Veron_Redshift The redshift of the nearest VV10 counterpart to the 2RXS source. Veron_Source_Number The running catalog source number in the VV10 catalog of the nearest VV10
  counterpart to the 2RXS source. Veron_RA The right ascension of the nearest VV10 counterpart to the 2RXS source. Veron_Dec The declination of the nearest VV10 counterpart to the 2RXS source. Tycho2_Number_Ctrprts The number of counterparts to the 2RXS source in the Tycho-2 catalog of the
  2.5 Million Brightest Stars (Hog et al. 2000). Tycho2_Nearest The source number of the nearest Tycho-2 catalog counterpart to the 2RXS
  source. Tycho2_Separation The distance to the nearest Tycho-2 catalog counterpart to the 2RXS source in
  arcseconds.
